uxNotes: Files is a plain sidebar link (group Organisation) with its own SectionNav instead of nav.ts sub-pages: the top bar shows no area › page title for it (PageHeader title only), unlike module areas.
Edit sheet has an explicit 'Speichern' button instead of <SaveBar>, and 'In den Papierkorb' next to it as an outline button without confirm (bulk trash does confirm).
'Zu {record}' only works for contacts; files attached to rentals, projects, products, employees, wiki pages have no way back to their record.
Folder is free text with datalist: typos create new folders; folder list is capped at 2000 files.
